Mara smiled, pinned the note beside her logbook, and prayed the sea would keep carrying lost things toward her door.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市褪去白日喧嚣，只剩路灯在潮湿路面上投下昏黄光圈。早起的早餐铺掀开蒸笼，白雾裹着豆香漫进巷口。末班公交车驶过空旷街道，车轮摩擦地面的声响格外清晰。远处高楼零星亮着几扇窗，像未眠人的眼睛。海棠花在微风里轻颤，花瓣落在空无一人的长椅上。这座城市尚未完全苏醒，却已在寂静中悄悄酝酿新的烟火气。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a small version of the same problem by calling itself, like asking a smaller copy of you for help.\n- It always needs a stopping point, called a base case, so it does not keep asking forever.\n- For example, to count stairs, you say: there is one stair, plus all the stairs below it, until you reach the ground."}
